title: Santa Claus Sticker Christmas Clipart
author: MeawwaDigitalArts
description:
📝 Description
Bring holiday cheer to your creative projects with this adorable Santa Claus Sticker Bundle! 🎅✨
This cute hand-drawn Christmas set includes 15 kawaii Santa-themed designs featuring Santa in fun poses, chimneys, reindeer, gifts, and festive doodles. Perfect for Christmas crafts, planners, stickers, cards, gift tags, party printables, and Cricut or Silhouette projects.
Each illustration has a cozy pastel palette and warm, friendly expressions — ideal for crafters, small businesses, teachers, and holiday lovers who enjoy sweet and playful Christmas art.
What’s included:
🎅 15 Santa Claus designs (SVG, EPS, PNG)
🎄 High-resolution PNG with transparent background
✂️ Ready for cutting machines: Cricut, Silhouette, etc.
⚡ Instant digital download — no physical product
Perfect for:
• Christmas stickers & labels
• Holiday party crafts
• Greeting cards & gift tags
• Scrapbooking & digital planners
Thank you for supporting handmade digital art! 🌟
